evidence: Adds a new Cap'n Proto interface definition (events.capnp) and implementation (interfaces/events.h, ipc/capnp/events-types.h) for an IPC Events service.
rationale: Adds an Events IPC interface streaming block and mempool notifications, directly addressing external integration needs that ZMQ cannot satisfy. 'External clients can subscribe to block connections, disconnections, and mempool additions or removals, with optional serialized payloads, fees, vsize, and sequence numbers' to fix long-standing gaps noted in #19462 and #23624.
